subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback remain intentionally fail-closed until the current browser reports `micMuted: false`, even when this delays or blocks audio for sessions whose microphone state is unavailable?
rationale: This changes an existing readiness behavior rather than only correcting an internal implementation detail, and the PR body presents the policy as intentional without maintainer-confirmed direction in the review context.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed readiness after repair
options.body: Keep the explicit-unmuted policy, but require fresh node health before recovery and obtain real-runtime proof for both local and paired-node paths.

options.title: Preserve legacy readiness
options.body: Retain the prior non-muted interpretation and narrow this PR to transcript and tab-recovery fixes until a separate readiness-policy decision is made.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed readiness after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit-unmuted policy, but require fresh node health before recovery and obtain real-runtime proof for both local and paired-node paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared meeting-bot design and authored the targeted policy implementation, making them the best available technical routing candidate.
